title: Natron Energy
summary: Santa Clara company commercialising sodium-ion batteries for industrial and grid applications.
bodyHtml:
Natron builds sodium-ion cells using Prussian-blue electrode materials, avoiding lithium, cobalt and nickel. The chemistry trades energy density for cost, safety and fast charging.

Its first market is data-centre and industrial backup, where space is less constrained than in vehicles.

Why it matters

  • Prussian-blue chemistry
  • Sodium-ion cells
  • Industrial and data-centre backup
